data.name: Prathyu
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Prathyu has made a big mark in cricket. With 63 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 74, with an average of 30.28 and a quick strike rate of 151.10. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 72 sixes and 162 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 40.1 overs, taking 20 wickets at an economy rate of 8.22. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
